summary: Route coverage by the 14 inventories is essentially complete: the only un-audited route files under src/app are /admin/analytics, /admin/appsumo, the root global-error.tsx, the generated icon/OG image routes and the /whiteboards redirect pair. The bigger completeness gaps are cross-cutting facts that several inventories got wrong or contradicted. Verified against the code: folded (offRail) apps are excluded from BOTH the rail and the More launcher (rail-apps.ts:156, apps-more-popover.tsx:64), so the launcher-based entry points cited by misc-apps, data, knowledge, people-ops and access-model do not exist; the rail highlight and secondary sidebar resolve from a persisted activeAppKey and never re-derive from the URL (click-sidebar.tsx:89, click-app-rail.tsx:60), so every 'matchPaths makes hub X highlight' claim is false; useGoToNav has zero importers, so the g-chord entry points listed by work-tasks, misc-apps, settings-pages and comms are dead; OsTitleBar's iconGradient is ignored (knowledge's gradient-tile finding is void); dark mode is a real user mode, not a leftover; the rail is 60px not 88px; and time.md is wrong that Timesheets is a rail icon (it is folded, like Automation, so Health/Usage/Logs have no sidebar entry anywhere). Surfaces nobody documented: mid-session 401/JWT-expiry UX (none exists), the cookie consent banner rendering inside the app, the next-intl layer with 11 catalogs and no in-app switcher, the keyboard-shortcut system as a whole (incl. ⌘⇧N quick capture), the people bulk-import dead end (/imports → Directory has no Import button, API has no caller), the Item comment thread composer, RealtimeClient behaviour, and the AGENT-level experience. The redesign must fix, in order: URL-driven navigation plus un-folding or deleting the 17 hidden apps and ~25 orphan routes; the fabricated/inert chrome (OsTitleBar trio, fake avatars, hidden empty-state CTAs, mock pages); the duplicate Task/Item models and duplicate surfaces; the seven-system access model with page/API disagreement and no read-only states; a single back-navigation convention; one visual system (five coexist, with two accent pickers, five loaders, two toasts, hard-coded #0073EA); cosmetic/unpersisted settings; and the per-subsystem broken primary flows (signup 404, onboarding loop, notetaker, clock, timesheets, public forms, sheet columns, kudos).
